theme: Blocking the attack without blocking the customers
title: Velocity Rules Against a Rational Attacker
strategies: amount-only naive filter: block transactions above a fixed percentile of observed legitimate amounts, velocity rule left off
threshold-fit-to-last-attack: set the velocity cap just below the observed attack's transaction count and the amount cap just below its transaction size, ignoring the attacker's adaptation economics

cost-aware rule design: search combinations of (velocity cap, window, amount cap) so the attacker's cheapest available split/delay adaptation costs more than the value it recovers, while staying as loose as possible to hold down customer friction

closed-form margin design: derive the minimum window widening and split count the attacker would need against each candidate rule, and invert against the attacker's per-unit costs directly rather than grid search
